InvoiceOptions.profile.doc: UBL invoice profiles of {@code /v1/create/ubl}. The profile picks the UBL CustomizationID and the rule set the invoice is validated against.

valueDocs.XRECHNUNG: XRechnung 3.0 for the German public sector.

InvoiceOptions.syntax.doc: XML syntax of an XRechnung created by {@code /v1/create/xrechnung}.

propertyDocs.CreateInvoiceRequest.options: Optional rendering and processing settings. Defaults apply when omitted.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.profile: UBL profile of {@code /v1/create/ubl}. It picks the UBL CustomizationID and the rule set the invoice is validated against. {@link UblProfile#PEPPOL_BIS_3} when omitted. The other create routes ignore it.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.syntax: XML syntax produced by {@code /v1/create/xrechnung}: UBL 2.1 (the default) or UN/CEFACT CII. Both declare the same specification identifier and pass the same BR-DE rule set. The other create routes ignore it.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.language: Language of the rendered PDF template of {@code /v1/create/zugferd}, and of the default texts the XML gains on every create route when the invoice has none, such as the payment terms. English when omitted.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.brandColor: Primary brand colour in {@code #RRGGBB} form, applied to headings and accent backgrounds of the rendered PDF template. Body text is never recoloured.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.pdfUrl: Public http(s) URL of your own PDF to use as the visual layer of {@code /v1/create/zugferd}. The generated XML is embedded into that PDF instead of the rendered template, so {@code language}, {@code brandColor}, {@code logoUrl} and {@code includeAdvancedProperties} are ignored. The XML create routes ignore it.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.logoUrl: Public URL of the seller's logo (PNG or JPEG, at most 2 MB and 4 megapixels), printed top left on the rendered PDF template and scaled to fit a 170 x 48 pt box.
propertyDocs.InvoiceOptions.includeAdvancedProperties: When {@code true}, the rendered PDF gains an "Electronic invoice details" section listing technical properties that a classic layout does not show, such as the specification identifier, the business process, party identifiers and electronic addresses. Defaults to {@code false}.
